Welcome to the workbench API.

Forms are the core resource. List them with ::operation{id="GET /api/forms" ref="op:v1:t2j6krk45xcfgb2e"}, which
returns a collection of ::schema{name="FormData" ref="sch:v1:6iocn62c7ru5zutw"} objects.

See the reference section for the full operation catalogue.
